title: Hover Card
description: A richer tooltip for things with a face: profiles, previews, and anything a title attribute cannot carry.
usage: For profile previews on names and avatars. Rich content only — anything actionable belongs in a Popover, which also works on tap.
a11y: Opens on focus at once and on hover after 300ms; closes 180ms after the pointer or focus leaves. Escape dismisses it without moving focus (WCAG 1.4.13). While closed the card is visibility:hidden, so screen readers do not read it inside the sentence. The card shifts to stay inside the viewport. Touch users get the Popover pattern instead; never hide essential content here.
